finding: The anytime-TD evaluator's population rule (`if (!row) continue`) treated ABSENT-FROM-BOXSCORE as DNP=void. Stat-row corpora omit active zero-touch players, so TRUE NEGATIVES — dressed players who scored nothing and whose market bets SETTLE as losses — were excluded from the calibration and both baselines. This is the mirror image of the props evaluator's absent-as-zero defect (P247), on the family that stayed public. TD was NOT independent of the defective class: same corpus, same absent-branch collapse, opposite default.

change.scope: Population conditioning ONLY, via the population contract v2 (classifyParticipation + outcomeForAbsentCandidate): absent+PLAYED_* scores outcome 0; DID_NOT_DRESS voids; AMBIGUOUS_IDENTITY / SOURCE_MISSING excluded and counted. The share gate (>=0.02 at fixed k=0.5), engine chain, mapping receipt and grids are unchanged.
change.reselection: The shrink/flatten selection (frozen grids k in [0.5, 2, 4], flatten in [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75], 2024 walk-forward logLoss, 2023 burn-in) is population-sensitive and is RE-RUN under the corrected conditioning — the gamma precedent: a parameter fit against a population artifact does not survive the artifact.

bars: Unchanged publication gate, applied to the corrected receipt: held-out 2025 model logLoss strictly below BOTH baselines (constant-lambda-same-shares and train base rate), computed on the identical corrected population. The board builder re-derives this gate from the receipt, so publication follows automatically.
